auth_description: ParkMobile US consumer Phonixx API at parkmobile.us/ParkmobileApi uses browser session cookies and PMAuthenticationToken. Sign in at parkmobile.io (Zone Parking), then auth login --chrome or --cookies-file. Not developer.parkmobile.io partner API.
description: Agent-native CLI for ParkMobile US consumer zone parking: zones, sessions, and hard-gated start/extend/stop.

novel_features.name: Hard-gated live parking
novel_features.description: Charges only with --enable-live-parking --owner-approved --confirm "START PARKMOBILE SESSION"; session start preview never posts checkout.

novel_features.name: Hard-gated extend/stop
novel_features.description: Extend and stop require matching confirm phrases and can_extend/can_stop checks from session metadata.

novel_features.name: Consumer session auth
novel_features.description: Chrome or Playwright storage-state cookie import; secrets stored mode 0600, never printed.
